[Section] Models
[source_id=12] We use the source code provided by BIBREF0 and BIBREF7 and evaluate using Transformer-XL large (Txl), ELMo original (Eb), ELMo 5.5B (E5B), BERT-base (Bb) and BERT-large (Bl).
